idea-plugin.name: Portcheck - Port in Use Fixer
idea-plugin.description:
Fix "port already in use" in one click, and see every port listening on your machine.

  • When a Run/Debug console says the port is taken (Node.js, Spring Boot, Tomcat, Django, Flask, Go, Rails, Vite, Next.js, .NET, Docker, …), portcheck tells you which process holds it and offers Stop it and rerun.
  • Ports tool window: every listening port with its process, PID and user; filter, stop (after confirming), open in the browser, copy the PID.
  • Tools | portcheck: check a port, find a free port, stop what's using a port.

Stopping is safe: portcheck never stops system processes or the IDE itself, and ports published by Docker, Podman or WSL get the right stop command instead. Works on macOS, Linux and Windows; portcheck is built in. Open source (MIT): github.com/roystondwork-dev/portcheck.
